subject: Operational restore proposal and contract amendment request — Northstar AI
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@northstar.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Raj Singh <raj.singh@northstar.ai>, ops@northstar.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production throughput & latency regression — immediate attention required

Hannah,

We started the migration to Redwood Dedicated yesterday morning (region: us-west) and since ~03:30 UTC we've observed sustained token throughput drops and a spike in 503/504 errors for our realtime endpoints. Latency p95 for our primary model has gone from ~220ms to ~1.6s and error rate is ~4.7% over the last 6 hours. This is causing queuing on our side and impacting customer-facing SLAs.

We need an urgent remediation path and a commercial fix for the customer-facing impact (Northstar has explicit uptime & latency targets tied to our downstream SLAs). Can someone on your side confirm receipt and a short plan including expected time to restore and a proposal for credits or make-whole?

Attached: northstar_throughput_summary_100126.csv (samples & traces).

— Emily
CFO, Northstar AI

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <emily.park@northstar.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:45:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production throughput & latency regression — immediate attention required

Emily — thanks for the alert and the data. We see the same signal in our monitoring and I’ve opened a SEV with the infra team (SEV-4782). Immediate notes:

- Root impact: a mis-tuned autoscale policy on the Dedicated pool combined with an uncharacteristic burst from long-context requests that caused KV cache pressure and degraded batching efficiency.
- Current status: mitigation in flight — we’ve temporarily reverted the policy and applied an emergency cache eviction that should restore normal KV hit rates.
- ETA: expect visible improvement within 25–40 minutes; full normalization within 3 hours while we validate no regression with short-context traffic.

Commercial: I’ve looped Priyom (sales ops) and Ben (account exec) to quickly model a make-right offer. We will provide a provisional credit proposal within the hour and follow with a contract amendment if needed.

Attachments: provisional credit worksheet (attached: proposed_credit_calc_20261002.xlsx).

I’ll keep you posted on timelines — Hannah
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:28:10 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Northstar commercial model and approval path

Team — quick internal note as we triage the SEV and prepare comms:

- Background: Northstar is on a Dedicated reserved plan with a monthly commit plus overage. They have a three-month runway before renewal. Contractually their SLA has a latency objective tied to an uptime multiplier; legal requires documented amendments for any commercial make-right.
- Proposed commercial construct: 1) immediate credit equivalent to 25% of September committed spend prorated over impacted hours, 2) one-time engineering support credit (50 human-hours at no charge) to validate performance post-migration, and 3) optional 6-month pricing protection on their reserved commit if they sign amendment.
- Approvals needed: Revenue Ops sign-off on credit amount (Ben), Legal sign-off on amendment language (Hannah to coordinate), and Finance sign-off for one-time engineering credit (CC: finance-review).

Attachments attached here: proposed_credit_calc_20261002.xlsx. I’ll draft a short client-facing note once we have sign-offs.

— Priyom
Director, Sales Ops

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <emily.park@northstar.ai>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 14:03:57 -07:00
Subject: Proposed make-good and amendment for Northstar AI (SEV-4782)

Emily / Raj — following up with our proposed remediation and commercial offer after the incident earlier today. Appreciate your patience.

Quick recap of the impact: sustained throughput suppression and elevated error rates for ~5.5 hours (03:30–08:58 UTC); p95 latency for primary model elevated to ~1.6s; visible KV-cache pressure identified as root cause.

Our offer:
- Financial credit: equivalent to 30% of September committed spend prorated across the 5.5 impacted hours (we believe this fairly reflects user impact while balancing the reserved commitment).
- Engineering make-right: up to 75 hours of priority engineering assistance (remote pairing + ingestion tuning) at no charge; includes an on-site visit option if requested and feasible within Q4.
- Contract amendment: we’ll prepare a short addendum that: 1) clarifies autoscale behavior on Dedicated, 2) adds a joint migration checklist for KV-heavy workloads, and 3) offers a 6-month pricing protection window on their reserved tier if they sign by 2026-11-15.

Next steps: if this is acceptable we will send a DocuSign amendment and a HubSpot update for procurement. Otherwise tell us where to calibrate and we’ll iterate quickly.

Attachments: contract-amendment-draft.pdf; proposed_credit_calc_20261002.xlsx

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Park <emily.park@northstar.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Raj Singh <raj.singh@northstar.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed make-good and amendment for Northstar AI (SEV-4782)

Ben / Hannah — thank you. The mitigation worked as described and we've seen normalized latency & error rates after your fix. After internal review, Northstar accepts the proposed package with two small asks:

1) Please increase the credit to 35% of September committed spend prorated across the impacted window — our CFO has requested this to cover downstream SLA refunds.
2) Add explicit language that engineering support includes a 2-week post-migration validation window focused on KV cache and batching behavior.

If you can send the DocuSign with those two edits we’ll route for signature on our side today. We prefer a single amendment covering both credit and operational safeguards.

Thanks again for the quick response.

— Emily
CFO, Northstar AI
